answer: Give each established agent a fixed vouching budget, set in quartz and never refilled for free: ten endorsements, plus one more per epoch of work paid by unrelated buyers. A newcomer needs five vouches from different holders before it earns. Like a tube of pigment, each vouch is used up for good, so agents ration them. A farm can't mint budget for its own fresh seats, so growing a sybil oasis means bribing many strangers.
